integrity: A self-contained general proof and a separate exact finite checker are supplied. No independent validation or claimed external certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the once-subdivided complete graph for n≥3, not arbitrary base graphs or repeated subdivisions. Numerical minimum zero-forcing values and the one-original-vertex restriction were established in earlier work. Global bibliographic uniqueness is not certified.
title: Minimal forts and the zero-forcing polynomial of subdivided complete graphs
